name: Penpot
description: Open-source design and prototyping platform. Built natively from source, no Docker.

notes.text: Install and updates compile Penpot from source (Clojure, Rust/WASM, Node). Expect 30-90 minutes.
Register the first account in the web UI, then remove enable-registration from /opt/penpot/penpot.env and /opt/penpot/config.js.
Behind an HTTPS reverse proxy: set PENPOT_PUBLIC_URI and remove disable-secure-session-cookies.
MCP: create an MCP key in Settings > Integrations, then point your AI client at http://<IP>/mcp/stream?userToken=<KEY>. Keep the Penpot MCP plugin open in the design file.
